examples.text: Desondanks konden regelmatig kapers de blokkade omzeilen en schade toebrengen aan de scheepvaart van de Republiek.
examples.translation: Nevertheless, privateers could regularly sail around the blockade and inflict damage to the navigation of the Republic.
examples.english: Nevertheless, privateers could regularly sail around the blockade and inflict damage to the navigation of the Republic.
